question: The cropping season between Rabi and Kharif is called ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zaid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Zaid:-**

 
 
• **It is a short-duration cropping season that falls between the Rabi and Kharif seasons.**
 
• It is typically practiced in regions with mild winters and hot summers, such as in the northern plains of India.
 
• Crops that are typically grown during the Zaid season include watermelon, cucumber, muskmelon, and vegetables like okra, pumpkin, and bitter gourd.
 
• The Zaid season is important as it allows farmers to utilize their land more efficiently and increase their overall productivity by growing crops during the off-season.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aman:-**

 
 
• It is a monsoon season crop that is sown in May-June and harvested in November-December.
 
 
 
• **Boro:-**
 
 
• It is a winter season crop that is sown in November-December and harvested in April-May.
 
 
 
• **Aus:-**
 
 
• It is a summer season crop that is sown in May-June and harvested in September-October.
